# Peak-exceedance classification (generated by `scripts/run_peak_events.py`; part P1 of the completion batch)

Declared in `docs/experiment_protocol.md` (entry of 2026-10-19) before it was computed; no model was fitted. Event: a day whose actual peak is at or above 228,464 MW, the 90th percentile of the daily peaks of the 363 complete days from 2023-07-01 to 2024-06-30 (known before the test period). A model predicts the event if its predicted daily peak is at or above the same threshold. 355 test days with all 24 valid hours in both the rolling 24 h-ahead and the day-ahead prediction sets; 45 of them are event days (12.7%; the reference year has 10% by construction, and demand kept growing, which is the likely reason for the difference). Rolling = the 24 h-ahead forecasts of the frozen main run, day-ahead = forecasts issued once at 10:00 on the previous day (naive: same hour on the latest earlier day). Intervals: 95% paired moving-block bootstrap over days (blocks of 28 days, 1,000 resamples).

| forecast | model | TP | FP | FN | TN | precision | recall | F1 [95% CI] |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| rolling 24 h-ahead | Best naive | 30 | 16 | 15 | 294 | 0.652 | 0.667 | 0.659 [0.435, 0.745] |
| rolling 24 h-ahead | Ridge | 35 | 9 | 10 | 301 | 0.795 | 0.778 | 0.787 [0.500, 0.887] |
| rolling 24 h-ahead | XGBoost S4 | 34 | 7 | 11 | 303 | 0.829 | 0.756 | 0.791 [0.533, 0.884] |
| rolling 24 h-ahead | LSTM L4 | 33 | 5 | 12 | 305 | 0.868 | 0.733 | 0.795 [0.500, 0.892] |
| day-ahead | Best naive | 30 | 18 | 15 | 292 | 0.625 | 0.667 | 0.645 [0.300, 0.766] |
| day-ahead | Ridge | 41 | 20 | 4 | 290 | 0.672 | 0.911 | 0.774 [0.529, 0.841] |
| day-ahead | XGBoost S4 | 36 | 10 | 9 | 300 | 0.783 | 0.800 | 0.791 [0.514, 0.889] |
| day-ahead | LSTM L4 | 32 | 6 | 13 | 304 | 0.842 | 0.711 | 0.771 [0.480, 0.874] |

Paired F1 differences (first minus second; 95% CI):

| first | second | F1 difference (CI) |
|---|---|---|
| XGBoost S4 (rolling) | Ridge (rolling) | +0.004 (-0.050 to +0.090) |
| LSTM L4 (rolling) | XGBoost S4 (rolling) | +0.004 (-0.080 to +0.058) |
| XGBoost S4 (day-ahead) | Ridge (day-ahead) | +0.018 (-0.058 to +0.084) |
| LSTM L4 (day-ahead) | XGBoost S4 (day-ahead) | -0.020 (-0.104 to +0.066) |
| XGBoost S4 (day-ahead) | XGBoost S4 (rolling) | +0.001 (-0.066 to +0.056) |
| Ridge (day-ahead) | Ridge (rolling) | -0.013 (-0.090 to +0.078) |
| LSTM L4 (day-ahead) | LSTM L4 (rolling) | -0.024 (-0.118 to +0.120) |

Differences whose interval includes zero are not distinguishable.

## Caveats

- With only 355 days and 45 event days the F1 values are noisy; the intervals are wide.
- The threshold was fixed from the year before the test period; the test-year base rate is 12.7% instead of 10%, so the setting is a moderately rare event.
- The classification is derived from the hourly forecasts (the predicted peak is the maximum of the 24 predicted hours); a model trained for the event directly could do better.
- The test year has been used several times for declared analyses; this only re-reads saved predictions.
